newsitem.title: UK: Prism Rail aims to raise 11 mln stg.
newsitem.headline: Prism Rail aims to raise 11 mln stg.

text.p: British railways operator Prism Rail Plc said on Monday it would launch a 5 for 28 rights issue at 330 pence per share to raise 11.2 million stg.
In a statement, the company said the money would fund part of the capital needed for its franchise for West Anglia Great Northern Railway Limited (WAGN), which is 19 million stg.
Prism was declared preferred bidder for WAGN on November 27 and expects to complete the purchase on January 5, 1997.
Prism also operates the LTS Rail Limited franchise, South Wales & West Railway Limited and Cardiff Railway Company Limited.
Prism is projecting profits of 11 million stg for the year ending March 31, 1998 and said net assets amounted to 33.2 million stg.
Prism is also shortlisted to tender for franchises for operating Northwest Regional Railways Limited and ScotRail Railways Limited.
Prism said it intended to pay dividends "as soon as Prism has the available distributable reserves to do so."
It said that would not be clear until after the current bidding process had been completed.
